observation.command: cd /tmp && curl -s -c kc-cookies.txt -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "client_id=admin-cli" -d "grant_type=password" -d "username=admin" -d "password=admin" -o kc-token.json && jq -r .access_token kc-token.json > kc-token.txt && echo "TOKEN OK" && TOKEN=$(cat kc-token.txt) && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/realms -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"realm":"my-realm","enabled":true}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"
